name: albe-rental-booking-system
description: レンタルスペースALBE 予約システム (Cloudflare Workers + Hono + D1)

scripts.db:seed:local: wrangler d1 execute albe_booking --local --file=./seeds/seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute albe_booking --local --file=./seeds/options.sql && wrangler d1 execute albe_booking --local --file=./seeds/tickets.sql && wrangler d1 execute albe_booking --local --file=./seeds/demo.sql
scripts.db:seed:remote: wrangler d1 execute albe_booking --remote --file=./seeds/seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute albe_booking --remote --file=./seeds/options.sql && wrangler d1 execute albe_booking --remote --file=./seeds/tickets.sql
scripts.db:reset:local: node scripts/reset-local-db.mjs && npm run db:migrate:local && npm run db:seed:local
scripts.deploy:setup: npm run db:migrate:remote && npm run db:seed:remote && npm run deploy
